change_control: Frozen study choices require a new experiment version; pending implementation/recipe artifacts must cite this digest and preserve these choices
claim_limits: Fixed implementations with matched action and original CPT exposure, not equal total compute or universal objective superiority
JEPA original front/h2 regression remains 7.22 percent with original gate FAIL
B0 original rendering-validity qualification remains disclosed
One training seed and previously inspected development/validation data; no untouched confirmation claim
Raw Pixel L1 and JEPA cosine scores are not directly comparable

requires: Both fixed-endpoint checkpoints and verified action exposure
All 210 evaluation attempts per arm with pairing and validity dispositions
Comparative success, failure, uncertainty, latency and compute reports

evaluation.baseline_report_reuse: Conditional on audited task, seed, initial-state, runtime and canonical input compatibility; otherwise reevaluate the same fixed B0 without training
evaluation.failure_and_retry_rules: Inherit libero-plus-v1; policy exceptions, invalid actions and timeouts count as failures; one documented infrastructure retry with original attempt retained
evaluation.future_loss_success_correlation: Exploratory within-method matched task aggregates where available; not causal or cross-metric evidence

paired_interval.interpretation: Exploratory task-resampling sensitivity on an inspected development panel; related variants and training-seed variation are not modeled
paired_interval.method: paired task bootstrap; same task indices for all arms

evaluation.pairing_validity: Default exact canonical settling-prefix and first-query image/state audit plus task/scene/initial-state/seed/runtime identities; any input mismatch makes the whole-panel contrast descriptive, with no dropped rows
evaluation.trajectory_validation: Full inherited epoch-1/2 measurements; no tuning, early stopping or checkpoint selection
evaluation.validity_rule_revision: Only through an independently justified versioned contract frozen before new comparison rollouts; never retroactive

excluded: Residual-pilot checkpoints and extra JEPA CPT
External human-video data or replacement action backbones
Week 8 inference coupling or continuation from trained M1/M2
Selection using dev-210 or test outcomes

future_supervision.grouped_statistics: Retain JEPA anchor-grouped teacher-relative variance over the complete logical batch, with the inherited singleton rule
future_supervision.jepa_teacher: Frozen detached canonical single-image v2 teacher
future_supervision.main_loss_reduction: Equal valid anchor/horizon pairs and equal cameras; complete logical-batch denominators; zero future term when no targets are valid
future_supervision.outer_weight_status: Must be sealed in child recipes after an equal-budget training-only pilot with prospective selection rules
future_supervision.validity: anchor+h < episode_length in the same episode; no cross-split or cross-episode targets

integration_requirements.demonstration_future_actions: Permitted only in the isolated training auxiliary predictor; prohibited in shared observation features, action decoder and rollout inputs
integration_requirements.feature_route: Common versioned differentiable route for Pixel and JEPA; exact tensor route is Step 2

required_child_artifacts: Versioned common OFT auxiliary feature interface and gradient/information-boundary checks
Future-target attachment and full-logical-batch loss/accumulation implementation
Prospectively sealed equal-budget training-only pilot examples, trial counts and selection rule
Sealed M1/M2 outer loss weights, new-module optimizer rules and numerical tolerances
Per-model resource limits, measured projections and interruption/recovery evidence

scope: Step 1 experiment freeze for M1 Pixel and M2 JEPA auxiliary action policies

action_training.action_loss_denominator: mean over the logical batch of all 8 x 7 action targets
action_training.input_and_output_contract: Same front/wrist RGB, state, preprocessing, action/state normalizers, predict-eight/execute-eight, 20 Hz as B0.
action_training.new_module_optimizer_and_loss_weights: Must be declared per method before production; matched across corresponding Pixel/JEPA and auxiliary/coupled comparisons.

batching_and_sampling.future_target_handling: Attach future targets to fixed action anchors; use predeclared masks for unavailable horizons, preserving every action sample.
batching_and_sampling.short_batches: Retain exact B0 per-update sample counts; no padding, dropping, merging or oversampling.

initialization.future_modules: M1/M3 share C_pixel; M2/M4 share C_jepa. CPT begins from pinned base representations; no silent B0 teacher or trained B0 weights.
initialization.optimizer: Fresh AdamW/scheduler for every core policy arm.
initialization.shared_policy_components: Fresh OFT action head, state projector and broad rank-32 LoRA as in the completed B0 run; verify shared initial tensors before adding independently seeded future modules.
